wants.topic: 100-year historical and nostalgic festival tradition documentaries
wants.evidence: The Divine Journey's '100 साल पहले' series for Kanya Pujan (38.26x vsNormal), Dhanteras (23.44x vsNormal), and Diwali (19.95x vsNormal) generated millions of views

wants.topic: Event-timed major festival Vrat Kathas with complete puja vidhi and dramatic story hooks
wants.evidence: FaKT Dharmik Katha's Karwa Chauth video achieved 17.27x vsNormal (1.76M views) and Govardhan Puja hit 5.63x vsNormal

wants.topic: Lesser-known Puranic sagas of major Rishis and Deities
wants.evidence: Bhakti Magic's Shukdev Rishi & Raja Janak (18.03x vsNormal), Mahadev & Sati/Mohini (9.22x vsNormal), and Amarnath Amar Katha (6.64x vsNormal)

wants.topic: Lighthearted, relatable character-driven animated Bhakti stories
wants.evidence: JagaLeela Studio's Adhaiya character series consistently driving 4.83x to 5.57x vsNormal

gaps: Deep historical documentaries tracing Indian spiritual traditions and festival evolution across the last century
Engaging narrative adaptations of Puranic philosophical dialogues (e.g., Guru-Shishya stories like Shukdev-Janak) simplified for mainstream audiences
saturated: Off-season daily chapter recitations (e.g., Kartik Maas Adhyay daily uploads with 0.01x vsNormal)
Routine off-peak Ekadashi Vrat Kathas without unique narrative angles
Sectarian saint stories grafted onto major temple legends (e.g., Sant Garibdas/Kabir Sahib Jagannath stories performing under 0.2x vsNormal)
